operation_proposals.source_operation: Post-generation regex extraction of genes and cell-type labels
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog contains serialization, tokenization, and selection, but no regex-based parsing and prompt-removal operation. The documented extraction is retained as an unexpanded boundary.

The catalog can represent selection, ranking, and indexed updates, but it has no operation that jointly validates generated gene names, replaces invalid names with an ignore token, and averages ranks of duplicate generated genes. The source-defined postprocessing boundary is retained unexpanded.

operation_proposals.source_operation: GPT-2 causal-language-model forward and autoregressive decoding
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog represents attention and sampling separately, but has no operation for the documented GPT-2 causal-language-model computation that maps prompt token IDs to next-token distributions. The model boundary is retained unexpanded.
